scope: Two injected destination write faults after native writes prove abort/uncommitted journal/retained verified store and same-destination hash-correct retry with unchanged sender bytes/reads. Eight focused cases per browser also cover existing corrupted-stream and delayed-error defenses. Copied-bundle retry-phase mutation removes save action and fails. Not actual disk exhaustion/OS permission revocation, physical Wi-Fi or new full97-case execution.
